US Egg Producer Culls Millions of Birds Due to Bird Flu

Cal-Maine Foods, the largest U.S. egg producer, announced it will cull approximately 1.76 million birds from its facility in Florida after it tested positive for bird flu. The outbreak affects a significant portion of the company's flock.
